entry.title: Russia’s Starlink substitute poses a security threat far beyond Ukraine
entry.summary:
The Kremlin is currently in the process of deploying a satellite communications network known as Rassvet, creating concerns for the Russian invasion of Ukraine and for the wider international security environment, writes Joshua Stein. The post Russia’s Starlink substitute poses a security threat far beyond Ukraine appeared first on Atlantic Council .
